import { Component } from "@angular/core"; import { FormGroup, FormBuilder, Validators } from "@angular/forms"; @Component({ selector: "app-registration-form", templateUrl: "./registration-form.component.html", styleUrls: ["./registration-form.component.scss"], }) export class RegistrationFormComponent { registrationForm!: FormGroup; // Use the names `name`, `email`, `password` for the form controls. constructor(private fb: FormBuilder) { this.createForm(); } // Initialize the form with validation rules createForm() { this.registrationForm = this.fb.group({ name: [ "", // Initial value [ Validators.required, // Field is required Validators.minLength(6), // Minimum length is 6 characters ], ], email: [ "", // Initial value [ Validators.required, // Field is required // Attach custom email validator via directive ], ], password: [ "", // Initial value [ Validators.required, // Field is required ], ], }); } // Handle form submission onSubmit() { if (this.registrationForm.valid) { console.log("Form Submitted Successfully:", this.registrationForm.value); } else { // Automatically mark all controls as touched to trigger errors this.registrationForm.markAllAsTouched(); } } }

Registration

Name is required. Name must be at least 6 characters long.
Email is required. Invalid email format!
Password is required.
